gold: Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum

selector.rationale: Evidence of an intramuscular abscess in the left levator scapulae muscle and a poorly defined collection in the left paraspinal musculature supports Paraspinal abscess as the most specific diagnosis.

rejected.label: Pyogenic infection
rejected.why: Too broad, as it is a general type of infection

rejected.label: Cervical lymphadenitis
rejected.why: Lack of specific evidence for lymph node involvement

rejected.label: Fusobacterium necrophorum infection
rejected.why: While the microbiological culture is positive for F. necrophorum, the clinical presentation and imaging studies more specifically support Paraspinal abscess
